# Machine-Generated Texts
## Data Provenance & Legal Status

This repository contains raw, machine-generated texts produced by different Large Language Models.

**Human Intervention: None.** These texts are unedited and presented exactly as generated by the respective model.

**Legal Status:** To the extent possible under law, the publisher has waived all copyright and related or neighboring rights to this work via CC0 1.0 Universal. This dataset serves as the primary source material for the future publication of an anthology of machine-generated texts.
